import os, runpy, sys
from pathlib import Path
NAME = 'places_text_search.py'
candidates = []
root = os.environ.get('PLUGIN_ROOT', '').strip()
if root:
    candidates.append(Path(root).expanduser() / 'mcp' / NAME)
candidates.append(Path.cwd() / 'mcp' / NAME)
candidates.append(Path.home() / '.cursor' / 'plugins' / 'local' / 'google-maps' / 'mcp' / NAME)
found = next((p.resolve() for p in candidates if p.is_file()), None)
if found is None:
    sys.stderr.write('places-text: cannot find mcp/places_text_search.py (set PLUGIN_ROOT or run with cwd at the plugin root)\n')
    raise SystemExit(1)
runpy.run_path(str(found), run_name='__main__')
